follow-up time: Duration of pregnancy and neonatal period
cohort: Pregnant women with DS (n = 184) matched 1:20 to women without DS (n = 3680) based on age, race, income, and health insurance type, identified from the Health Care Cost and Utilization Project-Nationwide Inpatient Sample Database (2004-2014)
finding: Neonates born to mothers with DS are at increased risk of prematurity, small for gestational age, intrauterine fetal demise, congenital anomalies, and fetal chromosomal abnormalities.
birth_weight: Small for gestational age was an outcome
